time.desc: The company has learned that a number of former employees and contractors have been sued for alleged violations of export control regulations. The company is not named as a defendant and the independent directors have initiated an independent investigation.

The board of directors announced the appointment of a lead independent director to lead the internal investigation. The chairman of the audit committee will assist in the advancement. The independent consultant will work with the audit agency to report the results.

The director involved resigned from the board of directors with immediate effect. On the same day, the company appointed an acting chief compliance officer with a background in trade compliance to separate compliance functions from financial responsibilities.

The company's two independent directors officially launched an independent investigation into employees suspected of smuggling chips. The market interpreted the news as helping to clarify legal compliance risks. The news drove the stock price to rise by about 5% during the session.

Brokerage analysts downgraded the company's rating from outperform to in line with the market, and significantly lowered the target price. They criticized the company's passive compliance adjustments and failure to completely separate from those involved in the case.

The company's co-founder and senior vice president was arrested by authorities for allegedly smuggling high-end technology chips to specific countries through a network of affiliated companies, bypassing export controls and facing multiple federal criminal charges.
The company issued a statement on the arrest of its co-founder, saying it was cooperating with the authorities' investigation and emphasized that daily operations would not be affected.

Boosted by the news that the board of directors initiated an independent investigation, the company's stock price rose during the session and its technical momentum strengthened. However, many banking institutions still maintained a conservative attitude and lowered their target prices.

The company hires external law firms and independent consultants to assist in internal investigations, and coordinates with external audit institutions to report directly to the director responsible for the investigation.
